methods.name: Explicit Euler

equations.label: angular momentum change (derived)
equations.location: derived by researcher; snippet confirms L not conserved by explicit Euler only implicitly

methods.stability: No step size gives bounded energy: energy grows linearly (orbit spirals outward) for any h>0 on Kepler (hairer1999notes snippet; blanes2008splitting snippet). Practical accuracy at e=0.6 needs h <= 1e-4 even for one period (pilot).
missing: All open copies (unige.ch, mcgill.ca, kit.edu, ucsd.edu, uvm.edu) were DNS/proxy-blocked; statements come from web-search snippets only (verified: false).
Exact explicit Euler step size in the Hairer figure is inferred (h=0.0005 from "step size 100 times larger"), not read.

methods.name: Symplectic Euler (p implicit / q explicit variant)

equations.label: symplectic Euler step
equations.location: Lecture 2, symplectic Euler (snippet; explicit for separable H)

assumptions: constant step size h (symplectic long-time properties are lost with naive variable steps: hairer1997varsymp)

properties.note: conjugate to Störmer–Verlet, so its global error at whole periods behaves like O(h^2 t) + bounded O(h) offset

methods.stability: Energy error O(h), bounded, no drift for nh up to exp(c/h) (backward error analysis; hlw2006 Thm IX.8.1 recollection). Orbit precesses clockwise (hairer1999notes snippet).
missing: All open copies (unige.ch, mcgill.ca, kit.edu, ucsd.edu, uvm.edu) were DNS/proxy-blocked; statements come from web-search snippets only (verified: false).
Which symplectic Euler variant the Hairer figure uses was not seen; both variants have the same qualitative behaviour but precess in opposite senses (researcher expectation, not sourced).

methods.name: Störmer–Verlet (velocity Verlet / leapfrog)

equations.label: velocity Verlet (one-step form)
equations.tex: p_{n+1/2}=p_n-\tfrac h2\nabla U(q_n),\ q_{n+1}=q_n+h\,p_{n+1/2},\ p_{n+1}=p_{n+1/2}-\tfrac h2\nabla U(q_{n+1})
equations.location: Sec. 1 (Newton–Störmer–Verlet–leapfrog method, p.400); exact equation number not verified

equations.label: two-step (Störmer) form
equations.location: Sec. 1 (Newton–Störmer–Verlet–leapfrog method, p.400); exact equation number not verified

equations.label: composition
equations.location: Lecture 2 (snippet: composition of the two symplectic Euler methods with step h/2)

methods.stability: Energy error O(h^2) bounded over exponentially long times (hlw2003 Sec. 4-5, snippet); linear global error growth (hlw2003 abstract). For Kepler h must resolve pericentre passage; pilot shows clean asymptotics at h=1e-2, e=0.6.

methods.name: Classical Runge–Kutta (RK4)
methods.stability: Linear stability interval on imaginary axis |h lambda| <= 2.83 (standard, not sourced here). Energy drifts O(h^4 t); global error grows quadratically (hairer1997varsymp snippet, by contrast with symplectic). Pre-asymptotic at h >= 2.5e-3 for e=0.6 (pilot).
missing: RK4 is not in the Hairer Kepler figures seen via snippets; its expectations are from general theory.

scenes.notes: Use Float64Array for (q,p). Global error must be measured against kepler-exact-solution at t_N = N h. Sample symplectic Euler order tests at half periods (conjugacy pitfall).
